name: io.github.tonyyang0504/spotify-mcp
description: Spotify Ads (Spotify Ads Manager) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Spotify for Developers app registered for the Ads API (the Ads API Terms must be accepted for it; allowlisting can take an hour).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The app's client secret (HTTP Basic on https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with your Ads Manager account (https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ads-api/quick-start); it does not expire. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_BUSINESS_ID
environmentVariables.description: Spotify Ads business id whose ad accounts list_accounts returns (GET /businesses lists yours).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SPOTIFY_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).
